channel.title: The Shawnee News-Star - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Shawnee News-Star (news-star.com)

item.title: Meeker girls, Chandler boys come out on top in Monday clashes
item.description: CHANDLER - When Meeker visited Chandler Monday, the key to victory was on the defensive end. Both victors prevented their opponents from having a single player reach double digits in scoring.

item.title: Hacker, Shaffer earn GAC softball awards after Bison 5-0 start
item.description: RUSSELLVILLE, Ark. – The first Great American Conference weekly awards for softball have been announced, and Oklahoma Baptist's Haley Hacker and Jaycee Shaffer have been honored.

item.title: CVEC announces 2026 Sharing Success grant application period is now open
item.description: SEMINOLE - Canadian Valley Electric Cooperative (CVEC), in partnership with CoBank, has announced the 2026 Sharing Success Grant application process is now open, inviting eligible nonprofit organizations to apply for funding through this community support initiative. The Sharing Success Grant is designed to strengthen and support local causes that impact the communities within and surrounding Canadian Valley Electric Cooperative’s service territory.

item.title: OBU men's basketball squad up to No. 10 in NABC rankings
item.description: Oklahoma Baptist (17-2, 11-2 GAC) reached another new high on Tuesday as the National Association of Basketball Coaches (NABC) slotted the Bison No. 10 in its NCAA Division II Poll.

item.title: OBU's Erik Madrid named GAC Defensive Player of the Week
item.description: Oklahoma Baptist 7-foot-2 sophomore center Erik Madrid was named Great American Conference Defensive Player of the Week on Monday.

item.title: AG: Operation Blunt Force dismantles criminal enterprise
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY – Oklahoma Attorney General Gentner Drummond announced Tuesday that his Organized Crime Task Force, working alongside 27 law enforcement partners nationwide, arrested 20 individuals linked to a sophisticated criminal enterprise.

item.title: 69 degrees and snow?
item.description: In true Oklahoma style, residents spent a beautiful 69-degree Monday afternoon out and about after a bout of bitter single-digit cold and several inches of snowfall last week. Looking worse for wear, the piles of snow that remain were melting at an accelerated pace due to the warm temps..

item.title: Tecumseh boys outlast McLoud in OT; Lady Redskins roll
item.description: After the first meeting ended with McLoud coming back to steal a win from Tecumseh, the rematch was bound to be heated.

item.title: SSC Baseball kicks off season with First Pitch Banquet
item.description: Seminole State College’s annual Trojan First Pitch Banquet was held Jan. 31 in the Enoch Kelly Haney Center..

item.title: Ten students to perform as soloists in OBU's Concerto-Aria Concert Feb. 22
item.description: The Oklahoma Baptist University Division of Music will present the 52nd annual Concerto-Aria Concert in the OBU Recreation and Wellness Center Sunday, Feb. 22, on the OBU campus in Shawnee.
